changelog: Operational Health moved into Settings → Diagnostics
Operational Health moved from the main navigation into Settings → Diagnostics.
Diagnostics now shows snapshot-only health together with system/runtime diagnostics in one operational support tab.
changelog_es: Salud operativa vive en Settings → Diagnóstico
El módulo de Salud operativa se mueve de la navegación principal a la pestaña Settings → Diagnóstico.
La pestaña Diagnóstico ahora carga en el mismo lugar la salud snapshot-only y el diagnóstico de sistema/runtime.
